products.name: Martex® Atelier Luxe Blanket
products.description:
Crafted for ultimate luxury, the Martex ® Atelier Luxe Blanket is designed to offer both comfort and style. Made from a blend of 70% cotton and 30% TENCELTM Modal fibers , this blanket provides a silky-smooth feel that is gentle on the skin, while also offering temperature-regulating properties . TENCELTM is known for its breathability and moisture-wicking abilities , keeping guests cool in warm weather and cozy during chilly evenings.
